name: CreateDataCache

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group to which the ECI instance created during the data cache creation belongs
parameters.help_zh: 创建数据缓存过程中生成的ECI实例所属的安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the ECI instance created during the data cache creation belongs
parameters.help_zh: 创建数据缓存过程中生成的ECI实例所属的交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The storage space for the data. Default value: default. You can specify a custom value for business grouping and to avoid path conflicts.

eci-system is a reserved space for ECI and cannot be used
parameters.help_zh:
数据的存储空间。默认为default。支持自定义，以便进行业务分组和避免路径冲突。

eci-system为ECI保留空间，不可使用
parameters.name: bucket

parameters.help_en: The path where the data is stored
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The name of the data cache
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The size of the data cache. Unit: GiB. Default value: 20. Evaluate the required size based on the actual data volume
parameters.help_zh: 数据缓存大小。单位为GiB，默认为20 GiB。请根据实际数据量评估所需大小
parameters.name: size

fields.help_en: The configuration parameters of the data source
fields.name: options

fields.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:
URL
NAS
OSS
SNAPSHOT
fields.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：
URL
NAS
OSS
SNAPSHOT
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The number of days to retain the data cache. The data cache is deleted after it expires. By default, the data cache does not expire
parameters.help_zh: 保留天数。过期会被清理。默认不过期
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en: The list of tags bound to the data cache
parameters.help_zh: 数据缓存绑定的标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of an existing Elastic IP Address (EIP) to associate. If the VPC does not have a NAT gateway configured, you can associate an EIP to pull data from the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
绑定已有的弹性公网IP（EIP）。
如果VPC没有配置NAT网关，可以绑定EIP，以便拉取公网数据
parameters.name: eip_instance_id

fields.help_en: The EIP bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Default value: 5
fields.help_zh: EIP带宽。单位为Mbps。默认为5 Mbps
fields.name: bandwidth

fields.help_en: The ID of an existing Internet Shared Bandwidth instance to attach
fields.help_zh: 绑定已有的共享带宽包
fields.name: common_bandwidth_package

fields.help_en:
The line type of the EIP. Valid values:

BGP (default): BGP (multi-ISP) line.
BGP_PRO: BGP (multi-ISP) premium line
fields.help_zh:
EIP的线路类型。取值范围：

BGP（默认值）：BGP（多线）线路
BGP_PRO：BGP（多线）精品线路
fields.name: isp

fields.help_en:
The metering method of the EIP. Valid values:

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth.
PayByTraffic: pay-by-data-transfer
fields.help_zh:
EIP的计量方式。取值范围：

PayByBandwidth：按带宽计费
PayByTraffic：按流量计费
fields.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the IP address pool. The EIP is allocated from this IP address pool. The IP address pool feature is not available by default. To use this feature, apply for the IP address pool privilege quota in Quota Center
fields.help_zh:
IP地址池ID。
EIP将从该IP地址池中分配。
IP地址池功能默认不开放。如需使用，请在配额中心申请IP地址池功能权益配额
fields.name: public_ip_address_pool_id

parameters.help_en: The parameters for creating and associating an Elastic IP Address (EIP). If the VPC does not have a NAT gateway configured, you can associate an EIP to pull data from the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
创建一个弹性公网IP（EIP）并绑定。
如果VPC没有配置NAT网关，可以绑定EIP，以便拉取公网数据
parameters.name: eip_create_param
